gap_analysis: Measured at the EP4-emulated per-GPU shape (runs/P-MOE/r1, r2): vendored megamoe_rubin NVFP4 single 16K launch 2193 us/layer (stage+kernel), 2x8K sub-calls 2124 us (-3.2%, bitwise equal) -> 195.4 ms/step; one 8K call 1077 us. Model (optables P3-16) 2.151 ms/layer at EP16; at the EP4-emulated link volume (0.8x bytes) the same formula gives ~1.6 ms, so the emulated kernel runs ~1.3x its model. Shared MXFP8 expert alone 742 us/layer (68 ms/step) vs model 406 us: the stock SiTU-and-mul alone is 265 us (3 libm tanhf per element) and two MXFP8 quant passes ~70 us. Side-stream overlap of the shared expert does not pay at this shape: the uncapped persistent grid leaves no SMs (2876 vs 2894 serial), and capping the MegaMoE grid by 16/32/48 SMs costs +12.6/+14.3/+22.2% MegaMoE time (best overlap -1.4%). Root-cause hypothesis (r4 + ncu next): the MegaMoE is per-SM-work bound, not only link-bound at this shape: the FC1 epilogue SiTU costs 6 MUFU ops per element (~160 us per 8K call at the MUFU rate on all SMs) plus NVFP4 requant; the model prices MOE.act at 36 us per 8K. r4 splits link vs compute with all-local routing.
